name: muse-codex-bridge
description: Consult, review, and collaborate with your locally authenticated Muse Code from ChatGPT desktop.

interface.shortDescription: Bring Muse Code into your desktop conversations.
interface.longDescription: Ask Muse for a second opinion, compare approaches, review code, or delegate a coding task through the official local Muse CLI. Persistent sessions preserve follow-up context. Each user signs in to Muse with their own account. Requires a local desktop task, Node.js 22+, and Muse Code 1.0.3+. Independent community integration.
defaultPrompt: Ask Muse to review my changes and compare its findings with yours.
Have Muse propose another approach to this problem.
Ask Muse to critique this plan, then work through the disagreements.
